responsibility: Declares the lightweight token-location abstraction used by the misleading-indentation warning machinery. It defines token_indent_info, helpers to extract location/type/keyword data from lexer tokens, and the public entry points for converting control-statement token triples into -Wmisleading-indentation diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Public header for misleading-indentation support: it provides token_indent_info, the token-to-indent helper template, and function declarations, while c-indentation.cc contains the source-column reconstruction logic and warning heuristics.
